title: M1 — Establish ownership, catalog inventory, and frame conformance
description:
## Outcome
A pinned inventory and an executable frame contract define the work without replacing VideoML’s framework-agnostic architecture.

## Ownership
toolchain, specification, player, stdlib; consult Babulus

## Completion
All child behavior stories have implementation and verification evidence. Update the parent initiative body with decisions, coverage, and remaining work. This is planned work, not a claim that the features already ship.
